name: cookery
description: Hands-free cooking in Codex voice with a one-second camera folder and inline visual references.

interface.longDescription: Cook with Codex Voice while an iPhone overlooks your kitchen. Cookery uses QuickTime on your Mac to save a camera image about once per second. Codex can inspect recent images, guide recipe steps, answer cooking questions, and display visual references. Requires a Mac, Codex, a compatible iPhone camera connection, and permission to capture the QuickTime window. Images are reviewed during the conversation; Cookery does not provide continuous supervision or measure food temperature. You control when capture stops and whether the saved images are deleted.
defaultPrompt: Let's cook. Set up my top-down kitchen camera and help me make dinner.
Check my cooking progress and show me how the next step should look.
